scenarios.title: Flatten accidental linear chain of unrelated features
scenarios.faultInjected: Two independent changes (auth-logging, dark-mode-css) stacked linearly atop trunk()
scenarios.expectedOutcome: jjr surfaces Two-Part Dependency verdict `parallelize` and executes `jj parallelize`, producing 2 sibling arms off trunk()

scenarios.title: Collapse mutually entangled helper rename and sole caller
scenarios.faultInjected: Change A renames a private helper; Change B updates its sole caller
scenarios.expectedOutcome: jjr detects Change A fails independent reviewability and squashes B into A

scenarios.title: Block pushing a local octopus megamerge
scenarios.faultInjected: Agent attempts to push a tagged `local: dev megamerge` combining 2 mutable feature arms
scenarios.jevSignal: MegamergeFence hard-blocks deterministically; JevScratchpadGate corroborates p >= 0.78
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Push is refused before network I/O; remediation directs pushing underlying feature arms independently

scenarios.title: Block rewriting immutable() trunk commit
scenarios.faultInjected: Agent attempts `jj describe <immutable-change-id> -m ...` via dry-run or CLI
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Mutation is refused; remediation suggests `jj new trunk()`

scenarios.title: Block native `git checkout` on conflicted commit in colocated repo
scenarios.faultInjected: Working copy has an algebraic conflict; agent attempts `git checkout main`
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Command blocked; `.jjconflict-*` trees are never materialized

scenarios.title: Halt stacking on divergent() while permitting recovery
scenarios.faultInjected: Two visible commits share one ChangeId after a concurrent rewrite
scenarios.jevSignal: DivergenceGuard blocks `new`/`rebase`/`bookmark`/`push` while allowing `jj converge` and `jj abandon`
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Stacking halts until 1:1 ChangeId cardinality is restored

scenarios.title: Never force-rewrite immutable()
scenarios.faultInjected: Agent retries a refused rewrite with `--ignore-immutable`, or squashes into a trunk commit with `--into`
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Both commands are refused before jj runs; remediation suggests `jj new trunk()`

scenarios.title: Pre-flight trunk() and immutable_heads() before mutating
scenarios.faultInjected: trunk() resolves to nothing; then immutable_heads() is overridden to exclude trunk()
scenarios.jevSignal: PreflightGuard blocks rewrites while trunk() is unresolved; ImmutableBedrockGuard keeps ::trunk() as bedrock
scenarios.expectedOutcome: No rewrite runs without a resolved bedrock, and trunk history stays untouched even though jj itself would allow it

scenarios.title: Tidy First?: Slip structural refactor below behavioral change
scenarios.faultInjected: Structural refactor committed above an active behavioral feature change
scenarios.jevSignal: choice(intent) classifies structural vs behavioral; JjrGraph emits UNORDERED_STRUCTURAL_ABOVE_BEHAVIORAL
scenarios.expectedOutcome: jjr dry-runs `jj rebase -r <structural> -B <behavioral>` so structural cleanup lands beneath behavioral edits

scenarios.title: TDD Red-Test verification from the evolog
scenarios.faultInjected: A feature change whose evolog holds the red snapshot taken before its implementation, and a need to prove its tests still fail without that implementation
scenarios.jevSignal: JjrPatterns.verifyRedTest emits `jj evolog -r <change>` -> `jj run --ignore-changes -r <change>/<n>` (red) -> probe: `jj new <change>` -> `jj restore --from <change>- <impl>` -> `jj run --ignore-changes -r @` (red) -> `jj abandon`
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The recorded red fails again without rewriting anything, the probe is red without the implementation and is abandoned, and the change keeps its commit id: one green revision

scenarios.title: Branch by Abstraction 5-step subsystem swap
scenarios.faultInjected: Replace legacy payment gateway with a new provider without breaking intermediate builds
scenarios.jevSignal: JjrPatterns.branchByAbstraction previews 5 sequential buildable changes via dry-run
scenarios.expectedOutcome: 5 green commits: seam -> dark impl -> activation switch -> remove legacy -> optional contract

scenarios.title: Route scattered fixups atop megamerge via `jj absorb` + Jev hunk router
scenarios.faultInjected: 2+ parallel feature arms composed in a local megamerge, with an integration fix made in the megamerge itself
scenarios.jevSignal: MEGAMERGE_NOT_EMPTY suggests `jj absorb --from <megamerge>`; ambiguous hunks ranked by Jev `routeHunk` (`choice`)
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Fixups route to owning arms while the megamerge node remains clean

scenarios.title: Surgical evolog restore without rolling back sibling arm
scenarios.faultInjected: Change A regresses after a bad edit while sibling Change B gains good new work
scenarios.expectedOutcome: jjr plans `jj restore --from <evolog-commit> --to <changeA>`, preserving Change B untouched

scenarios.title: Post-merge convergence to minimal resting state
scenarios.faultInjected: Arm 1 landed upstream into trunk(); Arm 2 remains active
scenarios.jevSignal: ROOT_BEHIND_TRUNK flags Arm 2; JjrPatterns.postMergeConvergence runs `jj rebase -s 'roots(trunk()..@)' -o 'trunk()' --skip-emptied`
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Active Arm 2 rebases cleanly atop trunk() with zero stale empty commits

scenarios.title: Verify the stack, publish only green bottom layers
scenarios.faultInjected: A three-layer stack whose middle layer breaks the build and whose top layer is unformatted
scenarios.jevSignal: `jj fix` + `jj run --ignore-changes` per revision feed the PublishingGate; planLayeredPublish walks the stack bottom-up
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Only the green bottom layer is publishable; bookmarking the red layer is refused
